title: Coding in Stenography, Quick Demo
summary: A short unscripted demo of writing FizzBuzz in JavaScript with a generator function on a steno keyboard, typos included. It gives a feel for what real coding in stenography looks like.
why: Whenever HN asks whether you can program with steno, this is the go-to demo showing it working.

quote.text: There was a nice demo of using stenography for programming by one of the Open Steno Project developers
